policies.title: EU, EEA and Swiss ordinary passports: visa-free overseas short stays
policies.summary: French central guidance expressly exempts EU, EEA and Swiss citizens. This records foreign ordinary-passport catalog mappings only, not French citizenship.
conditions: Up to 90 days; each overseas territory remains outside Schengen and has its own visa order.
A Schengen visa alone does not authorize overseas entry.
Excludes residence, work, transit, long-stay, diplomatic, official/service and special-document routes.

policies.title: Colombian ordinary passports: five named territories visa-free
policies.summary: France-Visas names the five destinations in the Colombian exemption. French West Indies is excluded because it is an aggregate catalog label, not the page's territorial scope.
conditions: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period for tourism, business or family visits.
No policy is inferred for the aggregate French West Indies destination.
Excludes work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official/service and special-document routes.
